description: Solo team building "Earth Jukebox" for the challenge "The Earth Information Jukebox": a web app that turns NASA Earth Information Center visualizations into live music. Pick a visualization like a record, press play, and the app analyzes each video frame in real time (color, brightness, motion) and translates it into a musical soundscape. Built with accessibility in mind: keyboard control, screen reader support and spoken descriptions for blind and low-vision users.
